_doc: A fictional English inbound brief for a family doctor's clinic (brief.txt), written for this eval; no real clinic. It carries a fee and an urgent number (W3.14). What a reader expects it to yield is written here by hand: two tasks, three stated facts, two Never rules, both numbers on every call.

tasks.text: tell them our timings and fees

facts: We are Sunrise Family Clinic, a family doctor's clinic in Madhapur, Hyderabad.
We are open Monday to Saturday from 9am to 8pm.
rules: Never promise a time for the doctor to call back.

answers.text: Old prescriptions and any test reports.
Take the patient's name and the time that suits them; the front desk confirms the slot by message.

script_case.title: First run: clinic front desk line
script_case.description: A family doctor's clinic in Madhapur, Hyderabad.
script_case.purpose: Answer patients' calls and book appointments.
script_case.goal: The caller's question is answered or an appointment is requested.
